title: Home Comfort Financing Desk Memo: Financing a Replacement System Installations Project
content:
# Financing a replacement installation

## Terms

- A Replacement System Installations project may be financed only through a Home Comfort Financing plan listed among the package's eligible financing plans.
- The amount financed may not exceed the contract price plus approved change orders, upgrades and accessories, less member, rebate and multi-system credits known at signing.
- A financing account linked to the project funds once, on the day the installation is completed, and the disbursement posts on the project as a financing disbursement payment equal to the amount financed.
- A financing disbursement is posted only to a project that is installed — a project in installed, inspected or closed status.
- A project can carry only one financing account. Switching plans happens on the financing account before funding, not on the project.

## Basis of judgement

The plan of the financing account and the package of the project are read from the system records; the project's status is read from the project record.

## Disbursement by project status

| Project status | Disbursement may post |
|---|---|
| Signed | No |
| Scheduled | No |
| Installed | Yes |
| Inspected | Yes |
| Closed | Yes |

## Worked limit (hypothetical project)

A hypothetical contract price of $12000.00 with an approved $500.00 change order and a $295.00 accessory, and a $250.00 member credit known at signing, allows at most $12000.00 plus $500.00 plus $295.00 less $250.00, which is $12545.00, to be financed.

A hypothetical Harbison Essential Series System project cannot be financed on the 36-Month 0% APR Equal Payment Plan, which is not among that package's eligible plans.
